messages.subject: Error in aes
parts:
I get this error when trying to plot:

> ggplot(D, aes(x=TAD, y=DV, color=DOSE) +
+ geom_point() +
+ geom_line(aes(y = IPRE, group=1)) +
+ facet_wrap(~ID, scales="free", ncol=3))

Error in aes(x = TAD, y = DV, color = DOSE) + geom_point() :
non-numeric argument to binary operator

D is my data table and it's all numeric. If you have any insight, that
would be great.
